title: Glucose–creatinine coupling for potassium prediction: small source gains do not transport to an independent hospital cohort
abstract: Log-glucose × log-creatinine context did not establish improved external potassium prediction beyond flexible additive routine chemistry: NHANES-to-UCI added-minus-base MSE 0.00099 (mmol/L)², joint-bootstrap 95% interval [-0.01470, 0.01786].
